title: honest-estimation-and-debt-for-the-token-economy-plus-cli-activi
goal: Honest estimation and debt for the token economy, plus CLI activity marking. (H) Calibrate cost estimates by measured reality: on out SUCCESS, record actual change weight (sum of change file bytes / 4, the honest bytes-to-tokens proxy) alongside the estimate next gave, into ~/.orion/calibration.json; next then shows '≈ N tok (calibrated ×0.8 over 5 changes)' using the median actual/estimate factor when history >= 3 entries, else the honest '(uncalibrated)'. (I) Deferred-debt registry: when shield issues a yagni WARN for a snippet, record the debt entry (~/.orion/debt.json: snippet path, LOC vs median, date); when the change completes and the snippet no longer triggers WARN, close the entry automatically; next's footer shows the open-debt count, track status lists them. (J) Budget zone in next: when the calibrated estimate of a candidate exceeds its proposal budget, append an honest WARN 'exceeds budget ~N tok — consider splitting' (advisory, never blocks). (L) CLI activity indicator: every direct CLI invocation prints a terminal marker so the user always sees when Orion is working — '⚙ orion:<cmd> <args>' at start on stderr and '✅ orion:<cmd> done' / '❌ orion:<cmd> failed — reason' at exit (same vocabulary as the existing MCP indicator, v0.8); plain text output on stdout stays untouched; the marker is skipped for clean-machine outputs (help, version --json, mcp protocol) where it would corrupt protocol or scripted output. Zero new CLI commands, zero new dependencies.
